scope: Twenty executed current-public-binary H/Z confirmations: eight unique raw points with z and Euler forced Arb, plus four normal Euler controls. Three actual mode combinations were run. Two rays over a finite radial window do not establish global angular/tangential bounds or integrability.
coordinate_kind: Raw spatial momenta [GeV] in the generation LMB; inspect -m --graph-id 0. No parameterization Jacobian or adaptive density.
state_physics: WH/WF threshold metadata, direct3D local UV with orientation localization, integrated UV, six-cut sum; Q=1000 GeV, mt=173 GeV, mh=125 GeV.
runtime_only_card_toml:
#:schema https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alphal00p/gammaloop/49d3cc84aa2c5d81506b2a5e82cc5bfeafab0e01/assets/schemas/runtime.json
[default_runtime_settings.general]
m_uv = 91.188
mu_r = 91.188
integral_unit = "picobarn"

[default_runtime_settings.kinematics]
e_cm = 1000.0

[default_runtime_settings.kinematics.externals]
type = "constant"

[default_runtime_settings.kinematics.externals.data]
momenta = [
    [
    500.0,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    500.0,
],
    [
    500.0,
    0.0,
    0.0,
    -500.0,
],
]
helicities = [
    "summed_averaged",
    "summed_averaged",
]

[default_runtime_settings.integrator]
n_bins = 16
min_samples_for_update = 64
n_start = 7500
n_increase = 0
n_max = 75000
discrete_dim_learning_rate = 0.25
continuous_dim_learning_rate = 0.25
seed = 1337

[default_runtime_settings.stability]
escalate_if_exact_zero = false

[[default_runtime_settings.stability.rotation_axis]]
type = "z"

[[default_runtime_settings.stability.levels]]
precision = "Double"
required_precision_for_re = 0.000001
required_precision_for_im = 0.000001
escalate_for_large_weight_threshold = 0.9

[[default_runtime_settings.stability.levels]]
precision = "Quad"
required_precision_for_re = 0.0000000001
required_precision_for_im = 0.0000000001
escalate_for_large_weight_threshold = -1.0

[[default_runtime_settings.stability.levels]]
precision = "Arb"
required_precision_for_re = 0.000000000001
required_precision_for_im = 0.000000000001
escalate_for_large_weight_threshold = -1.0

[default_runtime_settings.sampling]
graphs = "monte_carlo"
lmb_multichanneling = true
lmb_channels = "monte_carlo"
lmb_channel_weight = "inverse_jacobian"

[default_runtime_settings.subtraction]
esurface_existence_threshold = 0.00000000000001

[default_runtime_settings.h_function]
power = 3

z_arb.runtime_override_command: set process -p epem_a_tth -i NNLO kv general.mu_r=91.188 general.m_uv=91.188 'general.evaluator_method="SingleParametric"' general.enable_cache=false general.generate_events=true general.store_additional_weights_in_event=false 'h_function.function="poly_exponential"' h_function.sigma=1.0 h_function.power=3 subtraction.esurface_existence_threshold=1e-14 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.gaussian_width=1.0 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.dynamic_width=false subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.force_uv_dampers_to_one=false stability.check_on_norm=true stability.escalate_if_exact_zero=false 'stability.levels=[{"precision":"Double","required_precision_for_re":1e-06,"required_precision_for_im":1e-06,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":0.9},{"precision":"Quad","required_precision_for_re":1e-10,"required_precision_for_im":1e-10,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":-1.0},{"precision":"Arb","required_precision_for_re":1e-12,"required_precision_for_im":1e-12,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":-1.0}]' subtraction.disable_threshold_subtraction=false subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.sliver_width=10.0 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.smooth_sliver=false 'stability.rotation_axis=[{"type":"z"}]'

euler_arb.runtime_override_command: set process -p epem_a_tth -i NNLO kv general.mu_r=91.188 general.m_uv=91.188 'general.evaluator_method="SingleParametric"' general.enable_cache=false general.generate_events=true general.store_additional_weights_in_event=false 'h_function.function="poly_exponential"' h_function.sigma=1.0 h_function.power=3 subtraction.esurface_existence_threshold=1e-14 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.gaussian_width=1.0 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.dynamic_width=false subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.force_uv_dampers_to_one=false stability.check_on_norm=true stability.escalate_if_exact_zero=false 'stability.levels=[{"precision":"Double","required_precision_for_re":1e-06,"required_precision_for_im":1e-06,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":0.9},{"precision":"Quad","required_precision_for_re":1e-10,"required_precision_for_im":1e-10,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":-1.0},{"precision":"Arb","required_precision_for_re":1e-12,"required_precision_for_im":1e-12,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":-1.0}]' subtraction.disable_threshold_subtraction=false subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.sliver_width=10.0 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.smooth_sliver=false 'stability.rotation_axis=[{"type":"euler_angles","alpha":0.1,"beta":0.2,"gamma":0.3}]'

euler_normal.runtime_override_command: set process -p epem_a_tth -i NNLO kv general.mu_r=91.188 general.m_uv=91.188 'general.evaluator_method="SingleParametric"' general.enable_cache=false general.generate_events=true general.store_additional_weights_in_event=false 'h_function.function="poly_exponential"' h_function.sigma=1.0 h_function.power=3 subtraction.esurface_existence_threshold=1e-14 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.gaussian_width=1.0 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.dynamic_width=false subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.force_uv_dampers_to_one=false stability.check_on_norm=true stability.escalate_if_exact_zero=false 'stability.levels=[{"precision":"Double","required_precision_for_re":1e-06,"required_precision_for_im":1e-06,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":0.9},{"precision":"Quad","required_precision_for_re":1e-10,"required_precision_for_im":1e-10,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":-1.0},{"precision":"Arb","required_precision_for_re":1e-12,"required_precision_for_im":1e-12,"escalate_for_large_weight_threshold":-1.0}]' subtraction.disable_threshold_subtraction=false subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.sliver_width=10.0 subtraction.local_ct_settings.uv_localisation.smooth_sliver=false 'stability.rotation_axis=[{"type":"euler_angles","alpha":0.1,"beta":0.2,"gamma":0.3}]'

inspection_protocol: For each case, reset process runtime from the embedded runtime-only card, apply the named mode override command, then inspect -p epem_a_tth -i NNLO -m --graph-id 0 [-f for arb] --json-output OUTPUT --point followed by raw_point_tokens. Use a compatible read-only state with no save. This JSON uses a dedicated schema and is not directly accepted by existing REPLAY.md.
